title: This activates dogfooding in Ronda while the locked v0 contract and architecture still specify one dogfood rep
text: This activates dogfooding in Ronda while the locked v0 contract and architecture still specify one dogfood repository, `lhpaul/ai-dev-framework-template`. Reconcile the authoritative documentation with an explicitly approved scope change, or preserve the single-repository contract.
rationale: Real inconsistency between the dogfood change and the locked v0 contract (single dogfood repository); reachable through Ronda's binding docs. Owner approved the scope change via #103. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
